author: Keith G. Smith
text: Sounds like you need to use SkinTac. I’ve never lost a sensor due to coming off while prepping the injection site with it. I have two friends that use it and swear by it.

author: Trina Johnson
text:
I had one fall off after 3 days from sweaty workouts and Georgia humidity. 

Skin tac and an over patch works. I’m on day 7 with my current one. I buy the patches that cover it completely but I leave the circle paper in the middle still attached to the patch. This way I can change the patch if needed and it won’t be stuck to the monitor.
